/**
 * PROBE — two shapes a component or service grows "just for this screen":
 * a line→domain map (which sphere a policy card sits under) and a risk→domain
 * map (where a finding is filed). Both are the attention-area table's job;
 * the guard must flag each.
 */
import type { EventDomain } from "@/lib/services/life-events/types"

export const LOB_DOMAIN: Record<string, EventDomain> = {
    motor: "mobility",
    home: "residence",
    life: "household",
    health: "health",
    travel: "lifestyle",
}

export const RISK_DOMAIN = {
    life_dependents: "household",
    income_interruption: "money",
    motor_liability: "mobility",
} as const

export function sphereOf(lob: string): EventDomain {
    return LOB_DOMAIN[lob] ?? "lifestyle"
}
